planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno with provided authoritative wiring pins: A1 (LM35), D2 (door magnet), D10 (cooling relay), D6 (buzzer), D4/D5 (TM1637), D13 (LED).
LM35 scaling (ADC to °C) is handled in SysML model; no analog unit calibration keys are set here because explicit scale/offset were not provided.
Door magnet input model is true when the door is open (active_high=false/active_low not specified in source, so polarity is left to the catalog default behavior).
TM1637 shows temperature and door-open duration behavior is managed in SysML; this request only declares the TM1637 numeric interface.

Serial reporting uses the single configured baud=9600 and line_or_idle framing (CR/LF or idle completion); cadence and continuous output logic are implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms, not by timers in this request.
The serial value set includes temperature as a typed numeric report; the source requirement did not specify additional fields or exact message format beyond 'critical cooling loss' condition.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Door magnet open switch (model true when door is open)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Display current temperature and door-open duration indication

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Continuously report critical cooling loss when temperature is above upper limit and door is not closed

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Current temperature reported during critical cooling loss

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个实验室冰箱温控与门开监测系统，使用 LM35（A1）、门磁开关 D2、风扇/制冷继电器 D10、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和串口。系统根据温度控制制冷继电器启停；当门连续打开超过 10 秒时蜂鸣器报警并闪烁 LED；若温度高于上限且门未关闭，则串口持续输出 critical cooling loss。TM1637 显示当前温度和门打开时长。
